title: Marrying Carmen McRae at Gadsden, Alabama
summary: He had known Carmen since the 1930s; she came to his Alabama camp and they married before he went overseas so she could receive the soldier's wife allowance.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I didn't know you were married to Carmen.
Yes.
I didn't know that.
Oh, she came down to the camp and we were married.
Well, how long had you know Carmen?
Oh, I'd know Carmen since the '30s, because she lived across the street from me, along with Charlie Holmes, Albert Nicholas. They all lived in the same apartment building.
Well, no wonder you and unintelligible were friends.
But I was --
Well, Carmen was going to school, was going to high school when I met her.

That's right, she was going to high school when I met her, too. She was going to high school when I met her. And Billy and I, we became staunch friends. So then Carmen and I, when I found out Carmen was a friend of Billie's, that was it, and with Irene. I was right in the crowd. I was one of the gang, you know.
Well, I never.
And I asked Carmen, you know, would she come down and see me, you know, because it was so lonesome. I said, 'Well, if you have time, would you come down, if you have time?'
(End of proceedings as recorded.)

You had just finished about you asked Carmen to come down and see you.
Yes, and she did, and we decided to be married while she was there.
No.
So I told her, 'Well, listen Carmen, I'm going away probably, overseas, and if --,'
Oh, you got married before you went overseas.
Yes. I said, well --
And I didn't even say that this was Carmen McRae we were talking about, did I?
No.
No.
So I told her, 'Well, since I have really no family, and they pay wives a certain amount of money for soldiers who are going overseas --,'
That's right.
'So I would like for you to have it.'
That's right.
'Because you're my best friend.'
Yeah.
'And I would like for you to have that.'
In other words, since we loved each other, we've known each other for so long, well, let's get married now.
Yeah, before you go.
And we were married there in Gadsden, Alabama, in Etowah (PHONETIC) County.
(Laughter)
For goodness' sake.
And all the fellows in the band came down to witness for me and everything like that.
Fancy that. Well, that's tremendous. Well, then, so when you got back then, was Carmen -- Carmen was -- I guess she was on the road, was she? Or, she was home?
No, she was home. She was home.
She was home?
Yeah, she was.
Well, that was wonderful, wasn't it?
Yeah.
